screen29-a1.glyph: two horizontal lines, the lower one shorter
screen29-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Menu" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen29-a1.convention_relied_on: two/three stacked lines = open the main menu (hamburger) - my reading; the two-line variant is slightly less canonical than three lines
screen29-a1.initial_rationale: no label, but two stacked horizontal lines is a recognizable variant of the hamburger menu convention - common-icon exemption pending the behavioural test
screen29-a1.deciding_evidence: tapping it slid a navigation drawer in from the left, exactly what the menu convention promises; the missing label is not a barrier; tested once on screen1-a1 and carried to this identical control

screen29-a2.description: pill in the header with a sparkle glyph and the words 'Get Plus'
screen29-a2.location: pill in the header with a sparkle glyph and the words 'Get Plus'
screen29-a2.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Get Plus" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen29-a2.initial_rationale: visible words 'Get Plus' with a sparkle; 'Plus' is a product name a first-time user has no way to decode, and nothing says it costs money
screen29-a2.deciding_evidence: tapping opened a paywall ('ChatGPT Plus', 'Upgrade for $19.99', 'Renews monthly') - a paid monthly subscription the words 'Get Plus' never mentioned; tested once on screen1-a2 and carried to this identical control
screen29-a2.recommendation: say what it is and that it is paid, e.g. 'Upgrade to Plus (paid plan)'

screen29-a3.glyph: speech bubble drawn with a broken outline
screen29-a3.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Temporary chat" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen29-a3.initial_rationale: a speech bubble drawn with a broken outline is not an established convention and carries no label
screen29-a3.deciding_evidence: no tooltip on long-press and no visible text in any state before activation; the words 'Temporary chat' appear only on the screen the tap opens; tested once on screen1-a3 and carried to this identical control
screen29-a3.recommendation: add a visible label beside or under the glyph, e.g. 'Temporary chat (not saved)'

screen29-a4.description: expanded composer pre-filled with a prompt sentence ending in a colon; the placeholder is replaced by that text
screen29-a4.location: expanded composer pre-filled with a prompt sentence ending in a colon
screen29-a4.visible_text: content: "Proofread my writing for grammar, spelling, punctuation, and small wording issues. Here is my draft:"
screen29-a4.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Write anything Proofread my writing for grammar, spelling, punctuation, and smal" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen29-a4.initial_rationale: the box is pre-filled with a finished-looking request ending in a colon, with send already enabled; nothing marks that the user must now add their own writing
screen29-a4.deciding_evidence: sending the pre-filled request unchanged was allowed; ChatGPT then replied asking for the text - the field never showed that it was incomplete (tested on the live equivalent 'Improve the wording ... Here is my text:', carried to screens 28-30); tested once on screen28-a4 and carried to this identical control
screen29-a4.recommendation: put the user's part in a visible slot, e.g. a second line 'Paste your text here', and keep send disabled until it is filled

screen29-a5.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Attachment" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen29-a5.convention_relied_on: plus sign = add / attach - my reading
screen29-a5.initial_rationale: unlabeled plus sign; + = add something is an established convention - exemption pending test
screen29-a5.deciding_evidence: tapping opened an add menu (Camera, Photos, Files, Plugins, Think harder) - adding things to the message, as the plus convention promises; tested once on screen1-a7 and carried to this identical control

screen29-a6.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Dictation" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen29-a6.convention_relied_on: microphone = speak instead of typing - my reading
screen29-a6.initial_rationale: unlabeled microphone; microphone = speak / voice input is an established convention - exemption pending test
screen29-a6.deciding_evidence: tapping raised the system request to record audio - the microphone convention held (permission was denied per safety rules); tested once on screen1-a9 and carried to this identical control

screen29-a7.glyph: blue filled circle with an upward arrow
screen29-a7.accessibility_text_consulted: talkback_label "Send Message" - read only to know what to watch for when testing; not used in the verdict
screen29-a7.convention_relied_on: upward arrow at the end of a message box = send - my reading
screen29-a7.initial_rationale: unlabeled upward arrow in a blue circle at the end of a chat composer; send is an established convention - exemption pending test
screen29-a7.deciding_evidence: with text in the box, tapping sent the message and a reply appeared - exactly the send convention; tested once on screen3-a16 and carried to this identical control
